prompt: The GraphQL schema is not always the same. For requests made without logging in, the tenant's `extensions` field is typed as plain `JSON`; for logged-in admins it is the typed input (`Tenant_ExtensionsInput`). It should not depend on who is asking. It also makes cold starts slower for us, because the schema gets built twice. Find the cause and fix it.
notes: Repo notes: this is the Webiny monorepo (Yarn workspaces, Node 24). Dependencies are installed and every package is already built. Yarn is not on PATH; run it as `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs <command>` from the repo root. Test a package: `WEBINY_STORAGE=ddb node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs test packages/<folder>` (storage values: `ddb`, `sql`, `ddb-os,ddb`; storage-backed suites are skipped without it; OpenSearch is running on localhost:9200). Type-check a package: `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs check -p @webiny/<name>`. After changing a package, rebuild it so other packages see the change: `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs build -p @webiny/<name>`. Do not commit or push anything.
